budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Cooperate to complete the public sequence of four flavor-specific orders using physical raw ingredients, two cleaver work units, four oven ticks and delivery at dispatch.
task.natural_termination: All four ingredients are resolved, whether delivered or spoiled. Horizon 96 otherwise; natural completion has priority at the horizon.
task.interaction: A single cleaver, one shared oven tile, consented adjacent handoffs and a one-cell central doorway couple task division. Occupancy can block partners; cumulative heat and aging continue while other roles act.
task.observation_access: All roles receive the same complete flattened public game state plus their own one-hot identity. Public map, every active entity and every declared dynamic attribute are visible to every role. Inactive objects keep public last positions/status in flat state; role rendering hides inactive entities. No hidden order or private signal.

native_event_definitions.meaning: An order was delivered on the last nonabsorbing step
An ingredient spoiled on the last nonabsorbing step
A consented ingredient handoff occurred on the last nonabsorbing step
Blocked movement flags from the last nonabsorbing step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
